spec.expr: (sum(max by (source, database) (last_over_time({__name__="wolverine-inbox-count", service\.name="WordoGuessr.WebAPI", service\.instance\.id=~"${instance:regex}"}[2m])))) + (sum(max by (source, database) (last_over_time({__name__="wolverine-outbox-count", service\.name="WordoGuessr.WebAPI", service\.instance\.id=~"${instance:regex}"}[2m])))) + (sum(max by (source, database) (last_over_time({__name__="wolverine-scheduled-count", service\.name="WordoGuessr.WebAPI", service\.instance\.id=~"${instance:regex}"}[2m]))))

spec.description: Current total persisted inbox, outbox, and scheduled messages from collector samples no older than two minutes. Replica observations are deduplicated by source and database; missing telemetry remains No data.
